scoring_justification: Recomputation from raw artifacts is infeasible because the checker sandbox cannot re-run DFT/EPW calculations; checker compares agent's reported results.json fields to paper gold values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for band gap, phonon stability, mobilities, power factors, doping concentrations, short-circuit current from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'High performance photocatalytic and thermoelectric two-dimensionally asymmetrically ordered Janus-like MXene alloys', DOI 10.1039/d0ma00391c, Table 1 and text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported ranges and values: band gap 0.60 eV, phonon stable true, hole mobility 133.61-142.39 cm2/V/s, electron mobility 19.65-29.99 cm2/V/s, n-type power factor 33.7-49.8 muW/cm/K2, p-type power factor 15-16 muW/cm/K2, n_opt_doping 4.0e20 cm-3, p_opt_doping 2.5e19 cm-3, max_short_circuit_current 4.2 mA/cm2.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's published results, verifiable against the source.

outputs.description: JSON file containing the key reproduced quantities: electronic band gap, phonon stability, carrier mobilities, peak thermoelectric power factors, optimal doping concentrations, and maximum short-circuit current.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each field to paper-reported gold values with appropriate tolerances (band_gap: ±0.05 eV, phonon_stable must be True, mobilities: ±20% of midpoint of reported range, power factors: threshold_or_better, doping concentrations: ±50%, short-circuit current: ±20%). Gold values are hardcoded in the checker.
